audit.whatIsWrong: The text calls Titan's Wrath a 'passive shield' ('his single passive shield proc', 'his passive shield only eats one instance') and describes his ult as 'Dredge Line into ult into Depth Charge', plus 'a grounding ult'.
audit.why: Staggering Blow (P) is a first-attack root, not a shield. The shield is Titan's Wrath (W) on a flat 12s cooldown. Depth Charge IS the ultimate, so 'ult into Depth Charge' names one spell twice, and nothing in Nautilus's kit carries a grounding flag — the CC chain is Dredge Line knock-aside, Riptide slow, Depth Charge knock-up.
audit.corrected: Name Titan's Wrath as the W shield (12s flat), Staggering Blow as a once-per-target root, and the chain as Dredge Line into Riptide into Depth Charge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Dredge Line pulls Nautilus to terrain, so he can cut a retreat Garen has no dash to answer.
audit.why: Nautilus Q carries the terrain flag: colliding with terrain pulls him toward it. Garen's kit has no dash — Decisive Strike is a Move Speed burst — so Flash is the only answer to a wall-anchor cut-off.
audit.corrected: Hold Flash for the terrain hook, not for the damage; do not walk home along a wall he can anchor to.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line's cooldown is stated as 15s; the packet also flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: Riot data gives Dredge Line at 14/13/12/11/10s. That is the punishable window and the whole green-light system for stepping up.
audit.corrected: 14s at rank 1, and step up only during its downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is 'Skill 5/10' in both layers, but the packet levelChart has Garen there and the why-text already says a landed Q sets up a real execute on a low-mobility target.
audit.why: Demacian Justice true damage plus Nautilus's lack of an escape makes 6 a Garen window; the row contradicted its own why-text and the packet.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flips to Garen 6/10, matching the surrounding rows and conceding only 2+ items.

audit.why: Garen owns levels 1 through first item and loses the fully-built tank/chain-CC 1v1; the early/mid/late text matches the packet chart.

edits.before: Track Nautilus’s Dredge Line (Hook) (15s): His only engage. Dodge it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Dredge Line (14s at rank 1) is his only engage, and it anchors to terrain to cut you off. Step up on its downtime.

edits.before: Get hooked. Eat his passive root chain. Extend into his W shield. Chip damage doesn’t get to borrow the ultimate.
edits.after: Get hooked. Walk home past a wall he can anchor to. Extend into Titan's Wrath. Chip damage never borrows the ult.

edits.before: Track his Nautilus Nautilus Dredge Line anchor and passive root before you commit
edits.after: Track Dredge Line (14s at rank 1) and hold Flash for the wall, not the hook

edits.before: At 2 your sustained short-trade DPS still beats his single passive shield proc.
edits.after: At 2 your short-trade DPS beats one W Titan's Wrath shield plus a root.

edits.before: With Q silence into E spin you win every short trade; Nautilus can't sustain the chip and his passive shield only eats one instance.
edits.after: With Q silence into E spin you win every short trade; his W Titan's Wrath shield is a flat 12s and Staggering Blow roots once per target.

edits.before: Nautilus flips the lane as a tanky engage machine — Dredge Line into ult into Depth Charge chain-CCs you and lets his team blow you up.
edits.after: Nautilus flips the lane as a tanky engage machine — Dredge Line into E Riptide into R Depth Charge chain-CCs you and his team deletes you.

edits.before: This is where Nautilus wins — full tank with Dredge Line, a grounding ult, and Depth Charge, he chains CC and turns every fight into a coin-flip you can't walk out of.
edits.after: This is where Nautilus wins — full tank with Dredge Line, Riptide slows and a Depth Charge knock-up, he chains CC and turns every fight into a coin-flip you cannot walk out of.
